python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0062.png')

# Right edge at ground:
# The side wood face ends at col 291.
# What is the bottom row of col 291?
col291 = img[:, 291, :]
# wood color: BGR ~ [138, 174, 202]
is_wood = (col291[:, 0] > 100) & (col291[:, 0] < 150) & (col291[:, 1] > 150) & (col291[:, 1] < 190) & (col291[:, 2] > 180) & (col291[:, 2] < 220)
ys_wood = np.where(is_wood)[0]
print('col 291 wood rows:', ys_wood.min(), ys_wood.max())

# Let's inspect along col 291 around the bottom
for r in range(ys_wood.max()-5, min(512, ys_wood.max()+10)):
    print(r, col291[r])
"
